title: The Summa Theologica and the Catena Aurea
author: St Thomas Aquinas
translation: Summa: Fathers of the English Dominican Province (1911–1925). Catena Aurea: Newman edition (Oxford and London, 1841–1845).
attribution: Summa Theologica translated by the Fathers of the English Dominican Province (1911–1925). Catena Aurea translated under John Henry Newman (Oxford and London, 1841–1845): Matthew and Mark from the 1842 London edition; Luke and John as transcribed by Fr Joseph Kenny, O.P., without his own added passages. These translations are in the public domain.
